title: SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program — Schedule of Annual Allowances by Tier
content:
# Schedule of Annual Allowances

Under the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program the employer funds, for each participant and each allowance year, the allowances and pair entitlements set out below for the program's tier. All amounts are in US dollars and are employer-paid.

## 1. Footwear and eyewear allowances and pairs

| Tier | Safety footwear allowance per participant per allowance year | Footwear pairs per allowance year | Prescription safety eyewear allowance per participant per allowance year | Eyewear pairs per allowance year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 100.00 | 1 | 0.00 (not covered) | 0 |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 125.00 | 1 | 0.00 (not covered) | 0 |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 150.00 | 1 | 150.00 | 1 |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 175.00 | 2 | 175.00 | 1 |
| SafeStep Premier | 200.00 | 2 | 200.00 | 1 |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 225.00 | 2 | 250.00 | 2 |

An eyewear allowance of 0.00 means that prescription safety eyewear is not covered on that tier.

## 2. Supplementary allowances and items

| Tier | Prescribed orthotic inserts allowance per allowance year | Accessories allowance (laces, insoles and toe guards) per allowance year | Eye exam reimbursement per allowance year | Welder's metatarsal guard upcharge covered on top of the allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 0.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 | Yes |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 0.00 | 15.00 | 50.00 | Yes |
| SafeStep Premier | 40.00 | 20.00 | 75.00 | Yes |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 60.00 | 25.00 | 100.00 | Yes |

## 3. Reading the schedule

- **Per participant, per allowance year.** Each figure applies to one participant for one allowance year; the pair counts are the number of pairs a participant may redeem in that year.
- **Orthotic and accessories allowances** are extra allowances on top of the footwear allowance. A tier showing 0.00 grants no such extra allowance.
- **The metatarsal guard upcharge** column states whether, on that tier, a welder's metatarsal guard upcharge is covered on top of the allowance. On SafeStep Voucher Basic and SafeStep Voucher Plus it is not covered; on the four higher tiers it is.
- **Eye exam reimbursement** is the most reimbursed toward the participant's eye exam in an allowance year; it is 0.00 on the three lowest tiers.

## 4. Points of comparison between tiers

- SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear is the lowest tier with a prescription safety eyewear allowance (150.00, one pair).
- SafeStep Mobile Fitting, SafeStep Premier and SafeStep Enterprise allow two pairs of footwear per allowance year; only SafeStep Enterprise allows two pairs of eyewear.
- Orthotic inserts carry an allowance only on SafeStep Premier (40.00) and SafeStep Enterprise (60.00).
